scope: Pet deletion and deactivation for customers, receptionists and managers
rules: Only pets without any booking history may be permanently deleted.
All booking and care history is retained through deactivation.
Unfinished bookings must be completed or cancelled before deactivation.
Customers may only remove their own pets; groomers cannot remove pets.
Booking creation and removal share a transaction lock.
Inactive pets cannot be booked; profiles can be reactivated in the editor.
runtime_note: Restart the existing run.py process in VS Code, then refresh the website to load the new backend.
